options.name: backup_node
options.description: Backup node in the event that preferred_node is unavailable Can be set by C(node_uuid), C(backplane_ip), C(lan_ip) or C(peer_id) One of the options should be enough. In case that all are set, logical AND operation is used. Task will FAIL in case that node can not be uniquely identified.

options.name: preferred_node
options.description: Preferred node to run the VM Can be set by C(node_uuid), C(backplane_ip), C(lan_ip) or C(peer_id) One of the options should be enough. In case that all are set, logical AND operation is used. Task will FAIL in case that node can not be uniquely identified.

options.name: strict_affinity
options.description: Enable or disable strict enforcement of affinity strategy. If C(preferred_node) and C(backup_node) are not set (in task or in VM) and C(strict_affinity) is set to True, the task will FAIL.

options.name: vm_name
options.description: Virtual machine name. Used to identify selected virtual machine by name.
